blocks.text: Why a Chauffeur Makes Sense in Laguna Beach
Three practical reasons, specific to this city.
blocks.html: Three practical reasons, specific to this city.

items: Laguna is a hillside car city with very limited highway access and virtually no parking on Main Street or Pine Avenue, so a coach drops at the curb and waits.
Wedding parties are routinely split between bluff-top venues, the beach and downtown restaurants several miles apart.
The Pageant of the Masters and Festival of the Arts close streets entirely, making on-site parking impossible for a large group.
Guests frequently arrive through SNA about 20 miles away, and the last leg is exactly where a chauffeured pickup pays off.

blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle for a Laguna Beach Night

Capacity is the first filter, then cost per person. A stretch limo seats 6 to 8, a Chrysler 300 about 8, a Hummer 12, and a Sprinter limo up to 14. Our party bus seats 24. Below about ten people, two cars or a limo usually beats a bus. Above ten, the bus wins on cost per head and nobody gets left behind.
